   103	class Expr(object):
   104	    """
   105	    A simple expression class.
   106	    """
   107	
   108	    @staticmethod
   109	    def eval(expr, assignment: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
   110	        """
   111	        Evaluate an Eywa expression given an assignment of variables.
   112	        """
   113	        return Evaluator(assignment).visit(expr)
   114	
   115	    @staticmethod
   116	    def convert(other):
   117	        """
   118	        Ensures that the given object can be converted to an expression.
   119	        """
   120	        if isinstance(other, Expr):
   121	            return other
   122	        if isinstance(other, int):
   123	            return Const(Int(32), other)
   124	        if isinstance(other, Parameter):
   125	            return Var(Type.inner(other.type), other.name)
   126	        raise Exception(f'invalid expression: {other}')
   127	
   128	    @staticmethod
   129	    def has_match(type):
   130	        """
   131	        Determines if this expression has a match expression.
   132	        """
   133	        return HasMatch().visit(type)
   134	
   135	    def __add__(self, other):
   136	        """
   137	        Override the + operator to create a binary operation expression.
   138	        """
   139	        return Binop(self.type, '+', self, Expr.convert(other))
   140	
   141	    def __sub__(self, other):
   142	        """
   143	        Override the - operator to create a binary operation expression.
   144	        """
   145	        return Binop(self.type, '-', self, Expr.convert(other))
   146	
   147	    def __and__(self, other):
   148	        """
   149	        Override the & operator to create a binary operation expression.
   150	        """
   151	        return Binop(self.type, '&', self, Expr.convert(other))
   152	
   153	    def __or__(self, other):
   154	        """
   155	        Override the | operator to create a binary operation expression.
   156	        """
   157	        return Binop(self.type, '|', self, Expr.convert(other))
   158	
   159	    def __le__(self, other):
   160	        """
   161	        Override the <= operator to create a binary operation expression.
   162	        """
   163	        return Binop(Bool(), '<=', self, Expr.convert(other))
   164	
   165	    def __lt__(self, other):
   166	        """
   167	        Override the < operator to create a binary operation expression.
   168	        """
   169	        return Binop(Bool(), '<', self, Expr.convert(other))
   170	
   171	    def __ge__(self, other):
   172	        """
   173	        Override the >= operator to create a binary operation expression.
   174	        """
   175	        return Binop(Bool(), '>=', self, Expr.convert(other))
   176	
   177	    def __gt__(self, other):
   178	        """
   179	        Override the > operator to create a binary operation expression.
   180	        """
   181	        return Binop(Bool(), '>', self, Expr.convert(other))
   182	
   183	    def __eq__(self, other):
   184	        """
   185	        Override the == operator to create a binary operation expression.
   186	        """
   187	        return Binop(Bool(), '==', self, Expr.convert(other))
   188	
   189	    def __ne__(self, other):
   190	        """
   191	        Override the != operator to create a binary operation expression.
   192	        """
   193	        return Binop(Bool(), '!=', self, Expr.convert(other))
   194	
   195	    def get_field(self, field: str):

   201	    def __invert__(self):
   202	        """
   203	        Override the bool operator to create a unary negation expression.

   207	    def matches(self, regex: re.Regex):

   304	class Forall(Expr):
   305	    """
   306	    An array forall expression.
   307	    """
   308	
   309	    def __init__(self, type, expr, invariant: Callable[[Expr], Expr]):
   310	        if not isinstance(type, Bool):
   311	            raise Exception('forall expression expected bool return type')
   312	        if not isinstance(expr.type, Array):
   313	            raise Exception('forall expression expected array type')
   314	        self.type = type

   318	class Evaluator(NodeVisitor):
   319	    """
   320	    A class that evaluates an Eywa Expression and returns a boolean.
   321	    """
   322	
   323	    def __init__(self, assignment):
   324	        self.assignment = assignment
   325	
   326	    def visit_Var(self, node):
   327	        return self.assignment[node.parameter_name]
   328	
   329	    def visit_Const(self, node):
   330	        return node.constant
   331	
   332	    def visit_Not(self, node):
   333	        return not self.visit(node.expr)
   334	
   335	    def visit_Match(self, node):
   336	        return re.ismatch(node.regex, self.visit(node.expr))
   337	
   338	    def visit_Field(self, node):
   339	        return self.visit(node.expr)[node.field]
   340	
   341	    def visit_Forall(self, node):
   342	        old = self.assignment
   343	        array = self.visit(node.array_expr)
   344	        for element in array:
   345	            var = Var(Type.inner(node.array_expr.type.element_type), uuid.uuid4())
   346	            self.assignment = old.copy()
   347	            self.assignment[var.parameter_name] = element
   348	            expr = node.invariant(var)
   349	            if not self.visit(expr):
   350	                return False
   351	        self.assignment = old
   352	        return True
   353	
   354	    def visit_Binop(self, node):
   355	        e1 = self.visit(node.left)
   356	        e2 = self.visit(node.right)
   357	        if node.op == '==':
   358	            return e1 == e2
   359	        elif node.op == '!=':
   360	            return e1 != e2
   361	        elif node.op == '>':
   362	            return e1 > e2
   363	        elif node.op == '<':
   364	            return e1 < e2
   365	        elif node.op == '>=':
   366	            return e1 >= e2
   367	        elif node.op == '<=':
   368	            return e1 <= e2
   369	        elif node.op == '+':
   370	            return e1 + e2
   371	        elif node.op == '-':
   372	            return e1 - e2
   373	        elif node.op == '&':
   374	            return e1 and e2
   375	        elif node.op == '|':
   376	            return e1 or e2
   377	        raise Exception(f'Unknown binary operator: {node.op}')

   380	class HasMatch(NodeVisitor):
   381	    """
   382	    A class that checks if an Eywa Expression has a match expression.
   383	    """
   384	
   385	    def visit_Var(self, node): return False
   386	    def visit_Const(self, node): return False
   387	    def visit_Match(self, node): return True
   388	    def visit_Not(self, node): return self.visit(node.expr)
   389	    def visit_Field(self, node): return self.visit(node.expr)
   390	
   391	    def visit_Binop(self, node): return self.visit(
   392	        node.left) or self.visit(node.right)
   393	    def visit_Forall(self, node): return self.visit(node.array_expr) or self.visit(
   394	        node.invariant(Var(Type.inner(node.array_expr.type.element_type), uuid.uuid4())))

   498	class Function:
   499	    """

   503	    def __init__(self, name: str, description: str, inputs: List[Parameter], precondition: Union[Expr, None] = None):
